staff.name: Bridget Lynch
staff.basis: The staffing model puts 1 of this role in a tailoring establishment at the typical band and 2 at the high end, on period_convention. The tailoress, who sewed what the cutter cut. Analogue: the 1839 list's printed 'cloak maker and tailoress', counted under tailor, and the millinery rows above. This person is a reconstructed resident of the trade with no workplace of their own; the house is one the business layer already holds, and this row points at it rather than raising anything.
